title: National Commission's Monitoring of Performance of the State Commissions

content.scenario: A consumer in India files a complaint against a business, alleging that they have engaged in unfair practices. The National Commission receives this complaint and decides to monitor the performance of the State Commissions in terms of their disposal by calling for periodical returns regarding the institution, disposal and pendency of cases.
content.outcome: The National Commission monitors the performance of the State Commissions in terms of their disposal by calling for periodical returns regarding the institution, disposal and pendency of cases, for better protection of the interests of consumers and for that purpose, shall have administrative control over all the State Commissions in the following matters.
